text: Added an identified classes axis and a typed categorical vocabulary: ClassId, CategoricalTarget, PositiveClassPolicy, finite DecisionScore, receipt-linked CalibratedProbability tables, ordered CategoricalPredictions, and class/sample alignment checks. Bind-time coverage walks only each analysis selection and rejects missing training classes. Accuracy is per-sample, balanced accuracy is uniform mean recall with ordered per-class terms, confusion matrices declare truth rows/prediction columns, and BinaryRocAuc identities state positive/negative classes, score source, pairwise Mann-Whitney comparison, half-credit ties, direction, and weighting. JVM/JS suites pass 5/5; type-separation, malformed targets/probabilities, and missing score paths are covered; freeze and diff courts pass.
